lines.japanese: あとにはＲ－ウィングの待機要員が幾人かと、何事もなかったかのように演奏を続けている太鼓叩きと、そしてひとりの善良な一般市民だけが取りのこされた。
lines.english: That left several R-Wing reserves, the drummer playing on as though nothing had happened, and one decent, law-abiding citizen.

lines.japanese: 前衛芸術の仮装じみた白い顔が、ひとりの善良な一般市民に気付いて動きを止めた。
lines.english: The white face, like a mask from some piece of avant-garde performance art, went still when it noticed the one decent, law-abiding citizen.

lines.japanese: 俺は無視して太鼓に近付こうとした。とりあえず、あのハリューという男がこの中ではいちばん話が通じるような気がしたからだ。
lines.english: I ignored him and headed for the drum. Of everyone here, this Haryu guy seemed the closest thing to someone I could reason with.

lines.japanese: しかし、女装野郎でも太鼓野郎でもない男に呼びとめられた。
lines.english: But before I got there, a man who was neither the cross-dressing bastard nor the drumming bastard called out to stop me.

lines.japanese: 「アニキぃ！　なんだよ、来てたのォ～！」
lines.english: “Big Bro! Well, look who’s here!”

lines.japanese: 黒パイン野郎だった。やつは愛想よく、場違いな微笑みを振りまきながら駆けよってきた。それを目にした女装男もしずしずと近付いてきた。
lines.english: It was Black Pine. He came running over, all affable smiles wildly out of place here. At the sight of him, the cross-dressed man approached with stately steps of his own.

lines.japanese: 「ブラザー咲夜、そちらの客人は君が呼んだのか？」
lines.english: “Brother Sakuya. Did you summon this guest?”

lines.japanese: 「んイェス！　八木隼人クン、ブハハ俺の心の友なの！」
lines.english: “Nnyes! Hayato Goat! Ha! He's my dearest friend!”

lines.japanese: 「ええっ」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: アホぬかせ友人じゃねーよ。と思ったけど、変に否定してフレイムバーズの関係者と思われるのも面倒というか不愉快なので、俺はそれ以上なにも言わなかった。
lines.english: What a load of shit. I'm not your friend. But protest too hard and they might mistake me for one of the Flame Birds, which would be both a pain in the ass and a personal insult. So I kept my mouth shut.

lines.japanese: 女装男は鼻で笑うように長身から俺を見下ろした。キショい上に感じの悪いオカマだ。思わず俺はケツの穴をきゅっと締めた。
lines.english: The cross-dressed man gave a nasal little scoff and looked down at me from his considerable height. A creepy, nasty queen. My asshole puckered on instinct.
“...Hmph.”

lines.japanese: やつは俺には何も言わず、黒パインに向かって命じた。
lines.english: Without saying a word to me, he turned to Black Pine and issued an order.

lines.japanese: 「ブラザー咲夜、第一戦闘配備中だ、警戒を怠るな。赦されざる咎に裁きを」
lines.english: “Brother Sakuya, we remain at first battle stations. Do not relax your vigilance. Judgment upon the unforgivable sin.”

lines.japanese: 「赦されざる咎に裁きを！　ぎゃはっ！」
lines.english: “Judgment upon the unforgivable sin! Ha!”

lines.japanese: 咲夜は背筋を伸ばした。オウムは長いスカート（ぷっ！）をしずしずと引きずって、信奉する太鼓男の方へ向かった。
lines.english: Sakuya snapped upright. Parrot Head glided off toward the drummer he worshiped, his long skirt trailing behind him with stately grace—*pfft!*

lines.japanese: なんだありゃ。
lines.english: What the hell was that?

lines.japanese: 「なあ、おまえらさ──」
lines.english: “Listen, you guys—”

lines.japanese: 「や、ごめんねえアニキ。せっかく来てくれて悪りいけど、俺ら、あんま大司教に逆らうと肩身狭くなっからさァ。ちょっと仕事してくるわァ」
lines.english: “Sorry, Big Bro. I know you came all this way, but if we keep crossing the Archbishop, it’ll be hard to show our faces around here. Gotta take care of some business.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ぜんぜん構わねーけど……つか、なに。なにそれ、ダイシキョーって」
lines.english: “Nah, I don't care at all... wait, what? What's this ‘Archbishop’ thing?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、大司教はいまのあいつ。実質うちのトップ。あいつ最年長なんだけどォ、うひひ、ちょっとコレでコレでコレだから」
lines.english: “Oh, the Archbishop's the guy who just left. Basically our top guy. He's the oldest, but—heehee—he's kind of *this,* and *this,* and *this.*”

lines.japanese: 咲夜はまず手の甲を唇の横へ添え、次に人差し指で頬を上から下へなぞり、最後にその指をこめかみの横でくるくると回した。
lines.english: First Sakuya put the back of his hand beside his mouth. Then he traced an index finger down his cheek. Finally, he spun that finger beside his temple.

lines.japanese: オカマでヤクザでクルクルパー？
lines.english: A queen, a gangster, and a total headcase?

lines.japanese: 「あ、ダイジョブ、ダイジョブ。あの件に関してはちゃんと進めてっから」
lines.english: “Oh, it's fine, it's fine. I'm making good progress on that thing.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ヨユーヨユー、ぶはは。ま、詳しく知りたかったらここ見てよ。アニキはもう、うちの一員みたいなもんだし」
lines.english: “No, plenty of time, plenty. Ha! If you want the details, take a look here. You're practically one of us already, Big Bro.”

lines.japanese: 「え、ちょ、待てよ。待てって──」
lines.english: “Wait, hold on. Hold—”

lines.japanese: やつは俺のポケットへ名刺のようなものを押しこむと、こちらの反応も待たずに高架橋の際へ走っていった。どうやら外の見張りにでも向かったみたいだ。
lines.english: He shoved something like a business card into my pocket, then ran for the edge of the viaduct without waiting for my reaction. Apparently he was off to stand watch outside.

lines.japanese: 取りのこされた俺は、黒パイン佐久間がブッ込んでいった紙片をポケットから抜きだした。
lines.english: Left behind, I pulled the slip of paper Black Pine Sakuma had rammed into my pocket back out.

lines.japanese: なんだろう、名刺……にしちゃ名前とか住所がない。
lines.english: What was it? A business card...? Except there was no name or address.

lines.japanese: その代わり、黒い長方形の隅っこに、ほっそりした白抜き文字で『鷹は舞いおりた』って書いてある。そのすぐ下の細かい英字がエイチ、ティー、ティー、ピー……。
lines.english: Instead, one corner of the black rectangle bore the words *The Hawk Has Landed* in slender white lettering. Directly underneath, tiny Roman letters went H, T, T, P...

lines.japanese: ああ、あれか？　パソコンの？　インターネット？　よく分かんねーけど。
lines.english: Oh, was it that thing? The computer thing? The internet? Not that I really knew.

lines.japanese: ま、関係ねーや。パソコンなんて持ってない以前に、俺にはそもそも連中に関わるつもりがないんだ。
lines.english: Eh, who cared. I didn't own a computer, but more to the point, I wasn't planning to get involved with them at all.

lines.japanese: 俺はそのカードを縦に握りつぶして、尻ポケットに突っこんだ。不要なものだけど、ポイ捨て禁止条例を守るのが俺の偉いところだ。
lines.english: I crushed the card lengthwise in my fist and stuffed it into my back pocket. Didn't need it, but look how great I was: I still obeyed the anti-littering law.
“Now, then...”

lines.japanese: うざい連中がごっそりいなくなったところで、とりあえず落ちついて太鼓の音でも聴いていこうかと思った。せっかくいい席がたくさん空いたんだ。このまま帰るのもちょっともったいない。
lines.english: Now that the whole annoying crowd was gone, I figured I'd settle down and listen to the drum for a bit. Lots of good seats had opened up. Seemed a waste to leave now.

lines.japanese: なんだったらカルトな人気のカリスマ・ドラマーとお近付きになって、股のゆるいグルーピーでも一人二人ご紹介してもらったり──
lines.english: Hell, maybe I could get close to this cult-popular charismatic drummer and have him introduce me to one or two easy groupies—

lines.japanese: ──なんてお茶目なプランが閃いた途端、見計らったように演奏が止まった。
lines.english: —and the instant that charming little plan occurred to me, the performance stopped as if on cue.

lines.japanese: 「マジかよ。イジメかよ」
lines.english: “Seriously? You fucking with me?”

lines.japanese: 俺はひとりごちながらも、めげずに奏者の真ん前まで近付いて行った。いや、グルーピー云々ってのは冗談だけど。
lines.english: I muttered to myself and kept going, walking right up to the drummer. The groupie stuff was a joke, by the way.

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードは太鼓よりも一回り大きな木箱に腰を据え、敗戦後のボクサーみたいにうな垂れていた。わずかに肩が上下している。俺はその汗で湿った頭の上から声をかけた。
lines.english: Haryu Claude sat on a wooden crate a little bigger than his drum, slumped like a boxer after a loss. His shoulders rose and fell slightly. I called down to his sweat-dampened head.

lines.japanese: 「なに。今日はもう終わりなの」
lines.english: “What, you're done for tonight?”

lines.japanese: 返事はない。と言うより反応がない。頭を上げようともしない。
lines.english: No answer. More than that, no reaction. He made no attempt even to lift his head.

lines.japanese: だが腹は立たなかった。いきなり知らないやつに声をかけられたら、俺だってそうするかもしれない。
lines.english: But I wasn't angry. If some total stranger suddenly started talking to me, I might do the same.

lines.japanese: 太鼓男の三歩横で、大司教と呼ばれたオカマが出来の悪いお化けみたいな顔をして俺を睨んでいた。気安く話しかけるなと言いたいんだろう。だが俺は構わず続けた。
lines.english: Three paces from the drummer, the queen they called Archbishop glared at me with the face of a bargain-bin ghost. Probably telling me not to get chummy. I kept going anyway.

lines.japanese: 「あのさハリューさん。あんた、ここ何日か来てなかったみたいだけど、なんかあったの」
lines.english: “Hey, Haryu. You haven't been around the past few days. Something happen?”

lines.japanese: 理由を知っていながら俺はすっとぼけて訊いてみた。やつは少しだけ頭を上げたけど、それはまだ俺と目が合うほどの角度じゃなかった。聞きとりにくい早口の低音で、足元へ向けて独り言みたいにつぶやく。
lines.english: I knew the reason, but played dumb and asked. He raised his head a fraction—not far enough for our eyes to meet—and muttered at his feet as if to himself, low and rapid and hard to catch.

lines.japanese: 「鑑賞者が触れるのは作品までに留めておきなよ。表現者の素性にまで迫ったって得るものはないよ」
lines.english: “An audience should concern itself with the work and leave it there. Dig into the artist’s private life and you gain nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Uh-huh.”

lines.japanese: 不機嫌そうな、というか不機嫌そのものな声だった。要するに、客の分際であーちすと様に馴れ馴れしく声をかけるなということか。
lines.english: He sounded displeased. No—he sounded like displeasure itself. In other words, a mere customer had no business addressing the great Aaartist with such familiarity.

lines.japanese: あーちすと様はペットボトルのミネラルウォーターで喉を潤したが、頭は上げなかった。もしかしたら俺は、やつのイカれた取り巻きのひとりと思われているのかもしれない。うわ、それはすっげ不名誉。
lines.english: The great Aaartist moistened his throat with bottled water but never raised his head. Maybe he thought I was one of his deranged followers. Wow. Now that would be damn embarrassing.

lines.japanese: 「いや俺、Ｒなんたらのメンバーじゃなくて。つか、むしろアンタにアレ、苦情とか言いたいんだけど」
lines.english: “Look, I'm not a member of R-whatever. If anything, I've got a complaint for you.”

lines.japanese: ハリューは前髪を軽く横へ流しながら、真冬の波立たない湖面のようなその眼にようやく俺を映した。
lines.english: Haryu brushed his bangs lightly aside, and at last those eyes—still as a lake in deepest winter—reflected me.

lines.japanese: しかし、それはほんの一動作ぶんだけだった。髪を梳きおえると、やつの目玉は俺を逃がして油断なく左右へ走った。留まることなく泳ぎつづける回遊魚のような眼だ。
lines.english: But only for the span of that single motion. Once his fingers left his hair, his gaze slipped off me and darted warily from side to side—the gaze of an open-water fish that had to keep swimming forever.
“A complaint...?”

lines.japanese: ハリューは真横を向いたまま、さして興味もなさそうに訊きかえしてきた。その直後にはまた違う方角を睨んでいる。何か探しているのか、それとも相手を馬鹿にしているのか。
lines.english: Still facing directly sideways, Haryu repeated the word with no apparent interest. An instant later he was glaring in some other direction. Was he searching for something, or simply treating me with contempt?

lines.japanese: 俺はその場に腰を落として、頭の高さを合わせた。向こうがそっぽ向いてるせいで、視線はかち合わなかったが。
lines.english: I crouched there until our heads were level. Since he kept looking away, our eyes still never met.

lines.japanese: 「あんな、こないだ、そのＲなんたら言うおまえのワンフーが、刃物向けて俺につっかかって来たんだけど」
lines.english: “Listen. The other day, one of those fanboys from your R-whatever came at me with a blade.”

lines.japanese: 俺はケツを浮かせて座った姿勢から、太鼓叩きの男にライトなメンチを切った。やつはちらりとも見ずに答えた。
lines.english: Still half crouched with my ass in the air, I gave the drummer a mild dose of the stink-eye. He answered without so much as glancing at me.

lines.japanese: 「そうか」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいやいや、そうかじゃねーだろ。煎餅かてめえは。危うく刃傷沙汰だっつうの。黒ひげ危機一髪だっつうの。血まみれの天使だっつうのマジで」
lines.english: “No, no, no. Don't just say ‘I see.’ What are you, an optometrist? I nearly got stabbed. It was Pop-Up Pirate for real. A goddamn blood-soaked angel.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、だったらどうしろっての。無事でなによりとか言って、胸でも撫でおろせばいいのか」
lines.english: “Ahh, and what the hell do you expect me to do? Say I'm so glad you're safe and breathe a sigh of relief?”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　いやいや、そうじゃねえだろ、ちょっと、えぇ～？　だからあんだろ、こう、なんか、その……俺に謝るとか、こいつら叱るとかさぁ」
lines.english: “Huh? No, no, that's not it. Wait, what? I mean, isn't there... you know, something? Like apologizing to me, or yelling at these people, or...”

lines.japanese: 「はびこる性犯罪は氾濫したポルノが元凶か？　ステイツに肥満が蔓延してるのは、分厚い肉を挟むバーガー屋のせいなのか？」
lines.english: “Is the flood of pornography to blame for rampant sex crime? Is obesity endemic in the States because burger joints serve slabs of meat between thick buns?”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「あんたの言いがかりはそういうレベルだよ。俺はこいつらの保護者でも後見人でも何でもない、俺の責任範囲の埒外だ」
lines.english: “That's exactly how stupid your accusation is. I'm not their parent or guardian. They're outside the bounds of my responsibility.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 俺は言葉に詰まった。なるほど、森里から聞いたとおりだ。たしかに善良な一般市民とは言いがたいかもしれない。
lines.english: Words failed me. So Morisato was right. Yeah, maybe ‘decent ordinary citizen’ didn't quite fit this guy.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、まあ……」
lines.english: “Well, sure...”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、分かるよ？　あんたァ、思い込みの激しいファンに付きまとわれてるっつう、ただそんだけの立場かもしんねえけどさ」
lines.english: “Well, I get it, okay? Maybe you're just a guy getting followed around by fans who've got some crazy ideas in their heads, that's all.”

lines.japanese: 大司教の呪うような視線に気付いたけど、俺は遠慮しなかった。
lines.english: I noticed the Archbishop's baleful glare, but I didn't let it stop me.

lines.japanese: 「でもさあ、こいつらに悪いことすんなって言うぐらいはいいじゃん。タダなんだからいいじゃん。言えよ。言ってよ。ビシッとさぁ、ビシッとー」
lines.english: “But you could at least tell them not to do bad stuff. It's free. Free's good. Tell them. Come on, tell them. Lay down the law. Really lay it down.”

lines.japanese: 俺がそう言うと、ふらふらさまよっていたハリュー・クロードの黒い瞳が、正位置に戻ってきて止まった。
lines.english: At that, Haryu Claude's wandering black eyes snapped back into place and stopped.

lines.japanese: 「軽々しく無責任なこと言ってくれるもんだなぁ、あんたは」
lines.english: “You sure say irresponsible shit like it's nothing, don't you?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「一度でも干渉すれば繋がりができる、繋がりは枷となって自らを制限する。分かるかい？　その責任を取れない第三者に、俺をとやかく言う権利はないんだよ」
lines.english: “Interfere once and a connection forms. A connection becomes a shackle; it limits the self. Do you understand? A third party who can't bear that responsibility has no right to tell me what to do.”

lines.japanese: 「えええ……」
lines.english: “What...?”

lines.japanese: 俺はまたも言葉に詰まった。なるほど、こんな調子でスカした屁理屈並べて、都合の悪い言及をのらりくらりとかわすところはどこかの皇帝とそっくりだ。
lines.english: I got stuck for words again. I got it. The way he calmly lined up bullshit arguments and dodged anything inconvenient was just like a certain emperor.

lines.japanese: だが幸い、俺は気が長い。世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: Fortunately, I was a patient man. *May peace prevail on Earth*.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ言わせてもらうけどさあ、おまえソレ、客に対して態度悪すぎじゃね？　なってねえよ、接客もアフターサービスも全然。超なってねえよ」
lines.english: “Well, let me tell you something. Your attitude toward a customer is way too shitty. Customer service, aftercare—none of it cuts it. None of it even comes close.”
“A customer...?”

lines.japanese: 「客だよ。おまえの太鼓カッチョ良かったから、俺こないだ金置いてったんだよ」
lines.english: “A customer. Your drumming was cool as hell, so I left you money last time.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、そう。だったら返金いたしましょうファッキンボーイ。おいくら万円　ｄｉｄ　ｙｏｕ　ｐａｙ？」
lines.english: “Ahh, I see. Then allow me to refund you, Fucking Boy. How many bazillion yen did you pay?”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ……ばか、おま、金額とかどうでもいんだよ。そういうのは気持ちの問題だろ。殿様の一両とお百姓さんの一両じゃぜんぜん重みが違げーんだよ」
lines.english: “I-idiot, the amount's got nothing to do with it. It's the feeling that counts. A lord's gold coin and a peasant's gold coin don't carry the same weight.”

lines.japanese: 「それは道理だな。なかなかいいこと言うよ。で、百姓のあんたはいくら出した」
lines.english: “Sound reasoning. You make a surprisingly good point. So how much did you pay, peasant?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うるせえな、だから物理的には１円玉７枚ぐらいなんだけど、俺的にはもう７兆円規模の──」
lines.english: “Sh-shut up. In physical terms it was about seven one-yen coins, but for me, spiritually, we're talking seven trillion yen—”

lines.japanese: 「ふっ」
lines.english: “Heh.”

lines.japanese: 「笑うなよ」
lines.english: “Don’t laugh.”

lines.japanese: 「来たか」
lines.english: “He's here.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: やつの嘲笑は俺へ向けられたものではなかった。
lines.english: His sneer had not been meant for me.

lines.japanese: ひとところに瞳を留めなかった男が、いまは遠く一点を熟視していた。ハリューは座ったまま、しゃん、足踏みを始める。しゃん……しゃん……と、足首にくくった民族楽器のような鈴がゆっくり鳴りはじめた。
lines.english: The man whose gaze never came to rest had fixed it now upon one distant point. Still seated, Haryu began marking time with his feet. *Chime.* Slowly, the little bells tied around his ankles rang: *chime... chime...*

lines.japanese: 鉄道高架の外、森里たちが現れそして走りさっていった方向とは反対側から、長身の影がひとつ悠然と歩みよってくる。
lines.english: Outside the overpass, a tall shadow strolled in from the opposite direction from where Morisato and his crew had appeared and run off.

lines.japanese: しゃん、しゃん、しゃん……。
lines.english: Chime, chime, chime...

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハハハ！　お早い戻りだったなあ、くたばりそこねたカラスよ！」
lines.english: “Hahahahahahaha! Back so soon, Crow Who Failed to Die?”

lines.japanese: 影が哄笑を発した。白い息と煙草の煙がそのシルエットを取りまいている。
lines.english: The shadow loosed a booming laugh. White breath and cigarette smoke wreathed its silhouette.

lines.japanese: お兄系ハイブランドの上下。荒々しくうねったアッシュ・ゴールドの髪。爛々と輝く熱い瞳が、俺の姿を認めてさらに燃えあがった。
lines.english: High-end labels from head to toe in a carefully cultivated bad-boy look. Ash-gold hair surging in savage waves. Hot eyes blazed beneath it, burning hotter still when they found me.

lines.japanese: なるほど、森里たちはこの一騎打ちのための陽動だったんだろう。柳木原フレイムバーズの鳳翔はたったひとり、武器も持たずに敵陣へ現れた。首を縁取る毛足の長いファーが、そよそよと風に揺れているようだった。
lines.english: I saw. Morisato and his crew had been a diversion for this duel. Kakeru Ohtori of the Yanagihara Flame Birds entered enemy territory alone and unarmed. The long fur trimming his collar seemed to ripple softly in the wind.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　驚いたぞカラス。耳障りな鳴き声に招かれてみれば、意外なオトモダチとツルんでるじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Hah! You surprise me, Crow. I follow that offensive caw and find you running with the most unexpected little friend.”

lines.japanese: やつは顔を斜めに向け、火のついた煙草の先端を突きだした。闇に灯った赤い先端が、ハリューと共に屈んでいた俺の目を指している。
lines.english: He tilted his head and thrust the lit tip of his cigarette forward. The red point in the darkness aimed at my eye as I crouched beside Haryu.

lines.japanese: 「ようアミーゴ、懐かないハヤブサがカラスに付いたのか。どうした心境の変化だ、おまえも独り寝の布団が寂しかったのかあ……？」
lines.english: “Amigo! Has the falcon that tames for no man taken up with the Crow? What changed your mind? Did that empty bed of yours finally get too lonely...?”

lines.japanese: 「ハヤブサ……？」
lines.english: “Falcon...?”

lines.japanese: ハリューの回遊魚のような眼が一瞬だけ俺を捕えた。俺と鳳の関係を疑問に思ったんだろう。冗談じゃない、ねえよ、関係なんかねえよ。
lines.english: Haryu's restless fish-eyes caught me for a single instant. He must have wondered what connection I had to Ohtori. The hell with that. None. There was no connection.

lines.japanese: 「うるせえニワトリ。俺はただの通りすがりなんだよ。豚とゴキブリのくだらねえ戦争ごっこなんか知ったこっちゃ──」
lines.english: “Shut up, Chicken. I'm just passing through. Your stupid little make-believe war between pigs and cockroaches has nothing to do with—”

lines.japanese: 「赦されざる咎に裁きを！」
lines.english: “Judgment upon the unforgivable sin!”

lines.japanese: 俺の釈明を遮って、大司教の命令がガード下に凛と響いた。いまだこの場に待機していたＲ－ウィングの兵士たちは、その声に従ってひとりまたひとりと慎重な速度で前進を始めた。
lines.english: The Archbishop's command cut cleanly through my explanation and rang beneath the tracks. The R-Wing soldiers still stationed there obeyed, advancing one by one at a cautious pace.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Hahahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 鳳は敵軍の足元へ、デコピン弾きで煙草を投げすてた。そして──
lines.english: Ohtori flicked his cigarette at the enemy's feet with a snap of his middle finger. And then—

lines.japanese: 「ふアァァァ……！」
lines.english: “Haaaaah...!”

lines.japanese: ──岩山で翼を広げる猛禽のように、腰より低い位置で両腕を伸ばした。膝を落とし、心臓の拍動に近しいリズムで肩を上下させる。
lines.english: —he stretched both arms below his waist like a bird of prey spreading its wings upon a crag. He bent his knees, shoulders rising and falling almost in time with his heart.

lines.japanese: 構えを取ってないのにまるで無防備に見えないのは、狂気に侵された鮮烈な笑い顔のせいか。ハリュー・クロードとは対照的な、荒れくるう大海原のような眼だった。
lines.english: He had assumed no guard, yet looked anything but defenseless. Perhaps it was the vivid grin corroded by madness. His eyes were a raging sea—the perfect opposite of Haryu Claude's.

lines.japanese: 「邪魔だ、失せろ……ゴキブリにもハヤブサにも用はない……今宵はカラスと戯れに来た……」
lines.english: “You're in the way. Begone... I have no business with cockroaches or falcons... Tonight, I came to sport with the Crow...”

lines.japanese: 「ふン……相も変わらず、いい歳して寂しい男なんだなあニワトリ。俺はあんたと違ってひとりの過ごし方を心得てんだ。悪いけど他をあたってくれないかな」
lines.english: “Hmph... Still a lonely man at your age, Chicken. Unlike you, I know how to spend time by myself. Sorry, but you'll have to find somebody else.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、その太鼓！　貴様、あからさまにひとを誘っておきながら白々しいことを言うんじゃねえよ……」
lines.english: “Hah! That drum! Don't openly summon a man and then play innocent to his face...”

lines.japanese: 「クク、寂しかったんだろ？　いいぜえ……ちょうど俺も、くだらない余興のせいで血が凝りそうなところだ……」
lines.english: “Heh-heh. You were lonely, weren't you? Fine by me... That tedious sideshow had my blood on the verge of clotting anyway...”

lines.japanese: 「ならばその穢れた血流、この広き墓標に岩ばしる償いの涙と変えてくれよう！」
lines.english: “Then shall I transform that tainted blood into torrents of penitential tears rushing over this vast grave-marker!”

lines.japanese: 大司教がハリューの傍らで叫んだ。中性的な叫び声は不気味に反響して、黒板を掻くような不快さを鼓膜に残す。
lines.english: The Archbishop shouted from Haryu’s side. His androgynous cry echoed eerily, grating on the eardrums like fingernails on a blackboard.

lines.japanese: Ｒ－ウィングの兵士たちは歩幅を揃え、弧を描く一枚の壁となってじりじり目標に迫った。
lines.english: The soldiers of R-Wing matched their strides and became a single curving wall, closing inch by inch upon the target.

lines.japanese: 「イ゛エエェェーッ！」
lines.english: “YEEEEAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 鳳はゆらゆらと首を左右に揺らしながら、鼻筋に皺を刻み、挑戦的に長い舌を垂らした──
lines.english: Ohtori rolled his head slowly from side to side, wrinkled the bridge of his nose, and let his long tongue hang out in challenge—

lines.japanese: ──が次の瞬間、やつは翼を広げたまま駆けだした。
lines.english: —then, in the next instant, charged with his wings still spread.

lines.japanese: 「ヒァァァ──ッ！」
lines.english: “HRAAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 第一目標に選ばれたのは、気の毒にもあのパンクス気取りのパイン頭だった。
lines.english: The unfortunate first target was Pineapple Head, that would-be punk.

lines.japanese: 「ヤ、ヤロウっ！」
lines.english: “Y-you bastard!”

lines.japanese: 佐久間は慌ててポケットから手を抜いた。ご自慢の流麗な動作で、いつか見た光らない刃が飛びだす。
lines.english: Sakuma snatched his hand from his pocket. With that prized fluid motion I'd seen before, out sprang the blade that caught no light.

lines.japanese: しかし血に飢えた猛禽は、その程度の威嚇になど顔色ひとつ変えなかった。光らない切っ先をかわすまでもなく腕一本で払いのけ、そのままパイナップルの下の顎めがけ横なぐりの掌底一発。
lines.english: But so paltry a threat did not alter the blood-hungry raptor’s expression. He did not even bother dodging the unglinting point: one arm knocked it aside, and a horizontal palm-heel strike drove into the jaw beneath that pineapple crown.
“Guh!”

lines.japanese: 「ッシャァ！　クァァァッ！」
lines.english: “HRAAAH!”

lines.japanese: そして続けざま右隣の男に裏拳、左隣に中段蹴り。
lines.english: Then, without pause: a backfist to the man on his right, a midsection kick to the man on his left.

lines.japanese: 「クハハハハーッ！」
lines.english: “HAHAHAHA!”

lines.japanese: 一瞬にして人の壁に穴をこじ開けると、鳳はそこを駆けぬけ、ハリューが腰を下ろしている一点めがけて突進した。不意を突かれた信者たちが取りおさえようと慌てて手を伸ばしたが、間に合わなかった。
lines.english: In a single instant, Ohtori tore a hole in the wall of bodies, raced through it, and charged straight for Haryu. The startled believers flung out their hands to restrain him. Too late.

lines.japanese: 「カラス！　いま行くぞぁァァァ──ッハッハッハ！」
lines.english: “Crow! I'm coming for youuuuu—ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 屈んでいた俺は危険を感じて立ちあがった。しかしハリューは木箱に腰かけたまま動かない。呑気にミネラルウォーターに手を付けている。
lines.english: Sensing danger, I rose from my crouch. Haryu remained seated on the wooden crate. Calm as you please, he reached for his mineral water.

lines.japanese: 「是非もなし」
lines.english: “It cannot be helped.”

lines.japanese: オウム頭が崇拝する主をかばって前に出た。大司教は動じることなく背筋を伸ばしたまま、懐に手を入れてなにか取りだした。
lines.english: Parrot Head stepped forward to shield the lord he worshiped. Without the slightest tremor, the Archbishop kept his back straight, slipped a hand inside his clothes, and drew something out.

lines.japanese: 「裁かれよ、力に溺れる愚者」
lines.english: “Be judged, fool drunk on power.”

lines.japanese: 右手に掴んだそれを、やつは迫りくる目標に向ける。それは冷ややかな墨色の塊──
lines.english: He leveled the object in his right hand at the oncoming target. A cold, ink-black mass—

lines.japanese: ──ピストルだ！
lines.english: —a pistol!

lines.japanese: その戦慄すべき銃口を正面から見せつけられた信者たちが、足を止め、身を固め、うめくような声を連ねる。この禍々しい小道具の登場は、明らかにやつらにとっても想定外だったようだ。
lines.english: Confronted head-on by that appalling muzzle, the believers stopped, went rigid, and joined in a low chorus of groans. The entrance of this sinister little prop had clearly not been in their script either.

lines.japanese: 「弁えぬ狂気に沈黙あれ」
lines.english: “Let madness that knows no restraint be silent.”

lines.japanese: 大司教は銃の上から左手をかぶせ、重々しくスライドを引いた。がちゃりと殺人予告の音が鳴る。しかし鳳の脚は止まらない。引き金に死人のような白い指が添えられた。
lines.english: The Archbishop laid his left hand over the pistol and drew the slide back with ponderous ceremony. A metallic clack sounded the promise of murder. Ohtori did not break stride. A corpse-white finger settled upon the trigger.

lines.japanese: 「え、ちょっ、おまえソレ──」
lines.english: “Wait, what? That thing—”

lines.japanese: ただの威嚇だと思ったが、甘かった。薄明るいガード下にストロボを焚いたような人工の光が閃き、乾いた単音が鼓膜を経て俺たちの全身を震わせた（耳が痛てえ！）。
lines.english: I thought it was only a threat. Naive of me. Artificial light flashed beneath the dim viaduct like a strobe. A single dry report ripped through our eardrums and shook us from head to toe. (*My fucking ears!*)

lines.japanese: 「クァァァ──ッ！」
lines.english: “HRAAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、鳳の左半身がぶれ、わずかに脚がもつれた。だが、よろめきながらもやつの進攻は止まらない。弾は外れたのか──
lines.english: For an instant, the left side of Ohtori’s body buckled and his legs nearly tangled. Yet even staggering, he did not stop advancing. Had the shot missed—

lines.japanese: ──違う、だらりと下がった左腕は被弾した証左。燃える猛禽は片翼をもがれた。
lines.english: —no. The left arm hanging limp was proof he had been hit. One wing had been torn from the burning raptor.

lines.japanese: 「鳳っ！」
lines.english: “Ohtori!”

lines.japanese: 俺は思わず声をあげていたが、自分の言葉もおぼつかないほど聴覚がイカれていた。ついでに、声を張りあげたのは久しぶりだったから喉がからんだ。あたりには乾いた冬の夜みたいな匂いの硝煙が漂っていた。
lines.english: I shouted without meaning to, though my hearing was so completely shot I could barely make out my own voice. My throat caught too; it had been a long time since I had shouted. Gunsmoke drifted through the air, smelling like a dry winter night.

lines.japanese: 「ヒャアハァ！　痛くね痛くね痛くねえええ！　ちィィィっとも痛くねえェェェ！」
lines.english: “HAAAAH! DOESN'T HURT DOESN'T HURT DOESN'T HUUUURT! DOESN'T HURT ONE LIIIIITTLE BIT!”

lines.japanese: やつはまるで自己暗示をかけるかのように虚勢を張った。
lines.english: He blustered as if trying to hypnotize himself.

lines.japanese: 「カハハハハ！　ヴァガヤロやってくれたな雑魚がァ！　オーケェイ、貴様から沈めてやるぁァァァ！」
lines.english: “HA HA HA HA! YOU FFFUCKER, YOU'VE DONE IT NOW, YOU PUNK! OKAAAY—YOU'RE THE FIRST ONE I'M PUTTING DOWN!”

lines.japanese: 「く、くそっ、こいつ……！」
lines.english: “D-damn it, this man...!”

lines.japanese: 焦慮に駆られた射手が、次弾の照準を定めるべく銃を左右に振っていた。
lines.english: Panic seized the shooter. He swept the gun left and right, struggling to settle his sights for the next round.

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿もうよせって！」
lines.english: “You idiot! That's enough!”

lines.japanese: 俺は体当たりするようにその両腕を抱きこんだ。
lines.english: I body-checked him and pinned both his arms in mine.

lines.japanese: 「アホかてめえは、空気読めっつの！　ガキの遊びにガチの凶器持ちこんでんじゃねえよ！」
lines.english: “Are you stupid? Read the fucking room! Don't bring a real weapon into a bunch of kids playing war!”

lines.japanese: 「介入するな俗人！　これは聖戦であるぞ！」
lines.english: “Do not interfere, vulgarian! This is a holy war!”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿！　おまえアタマやべえって！」
lines.english: “Idiot! You are seriously out of your mind!”

lines.japanese: 「おいっ！　おいカラス、ボケッとしてねーでてめえが止めろ！」
lines.english: “Hey! Hey, Crow! Don't sit there in a daze—you're the one who needs to stop him!”

lines.japanese: 俺はハリューに怒鳴りながら、オウム頭と激しく揉みあった。
lines.english: I grappled violently with Parrot Head while shouting at Haryu.

lines.japanese: ふたたび火花が散り、あの暴力的な衝撃がまた耳をつんざいた。オウム頭の腕を通じて、微弱ながら血の凍るような振動が伝わった。
lines.english: Sparks scattered again, and the same violent shock tore into my ears. Through Parrot Head's arm came a faint vibration that chilled my blood.

lines.japanese: やつは銃口も定まらないまま、自動拳銃の引き金を闇雲に引いた。俺の腕に抱きすくめられながら、気が狂れたように二発、三発、四発と立て続けて乱射する。
lines.english: With the muzzle aimed at nothing, he squeezed the automatic pistol's trigger blindly. Locked in my arms, he fired in a frenzy—two shots, three, four in rapid succession.

lines.japanese: マズルフラッシュが稲光のように薄闇を白く染め、コンクリートを削る不吉な銃声が方々で弾けた。
lines.english: Muzzle flashes bleached the half-light white as lightning. Ominous gunshots burst in every direction, biting chunks from the concrete.

lines.japanese: パンクやゴシックのいたいけな子供たちは恐慌をきたした。ある者は頭をかばってその場にうずくまり、ある者は腰を抜かして尻餅をつき──また中には、悲鳴をあげて遁走する者さえいた。
lines.english: The innocent little children in punk and goth costumes dissolved into panic. Some covered their heads and crouched in place. Some lost all strength in their legs and landed on their asses. Some even screamed and fled.

lines.japanese: しかしハリュー・クロードはただひとり、この期に及んでなお、木箱の上で我関せずを決めこんでいた。ごくり、ごくり。続けざまに水を呷る。
lines.english: But even now, Haryu Claude alone sat on his wooden crate like none of this had anything to do with him. Gulp, gulp. He kept chugging water.

lines.japanese: 「大司教！　やめろ馬鹿、それァやり過ぎだっつんだよ！　おまえ、鳳殺す気か！」
lines.english: “Archbishop! Stop, idiot! This is way too far! Are you trying to kill Ohtori?”

lines.japanese: 「き、貴様ァ……離、せと、言うのが……ッ！」
lines.english: “Y-you... I said let... go...!”

lines.japanese: 「うっ！」
lines.english: “Ugh!”

lines.japanese: 大司教が至近距離でその極彩色の頭を打ちおろした。銃にばかり気を取られていた俺は、目と鼻を挫かれた。星が飛び、痛みが駆けぬけた。
lines.english: At point-blank range, the Archbishop brought that riot-colored head crashing down. With all my attention on the gun, I took the blow across the eyes and nose. Stars burst. Pain ripped through me.

lines.japanese: やつはその一瞬で腕を引き、組みついていた俺を振りほどいた。
lines.english: In that instant, he jerked his arms back and tore free of my grip.

lines.japanese: 「離せと言うのが分ッかんねえのかあああ！」
lines.english: “DON'T YOU UNDERSTAND ME WHEN I SAY LET GOOOO?!”

lines.japanese: しまった──！
lines.english: Damn it—!

lines.japanese: 解きはなたれた銃口がたちまち俺の視界いっぱいに飛びこんだ。身の毛もよだつ暗い空洞。引き金にかかった白い指。それを引くことができる腐った眼。
lines.english: The liberated muzzle leaped at once to fill my entire vision. A dark hollow that made every hair stand on end. A white finger curled over the trigger. Rotten eyes willing to pull it.

lines.japanese: 血が凍りついた。
lines.english: My blood froze.

lines.japanese: 暗い空洞。引き金。ひとを殺せる眼。死の予感。
lines.english: The dark hollow. The trigger. Eyes that could kill a man. The premonition of death.

lines.japanese: 本能的な恐怖が刹那の世界を凍結させた。現実が保留された永い一瞬。殴られてもいない首の後ろに、ずきりと鋭い痛みが走った。どこかで誰かが俺を嗤っていた。
lines.english: Instinctive terror froze that split second into a world of its own. One endless moment with reality suspended. Though nothing had struck me there, a sharp pain stabbed through the back of my neck. Somewhere, someone was laughing at me.

lines.japanese: じいさん、小鳩、鷲介、タカシ、ヨージ、それから鳴。愛しいやつらの顔が停止した時間と思考の中を駆けぬける。そして世界は色を失い、白い帳が降り、内なる声が俺を嗤う──
lines.english: Grandpa. Kobato. Shusuke. Takashi. Yoji. Then Naru. The faces of those I loved raced through arrested time and thought. The world lost its color. A white curtain fell. The voice inside me laughed—

lines.japanese: 「それァ俺ンだァァァッッッ！」
lines.english: “THAT ONE'S MIIIIINE!”

lines.japanese: 「しまっ──」
lines.english: “Damn—”

lines.japanese: 霞みゆく視界の中、暗い空洞が本来の獲物を追って大きく脇へ流れていった。
lines.english: In my whitening vision, the dark hollow swung violently aside to pursue its rightful prey.

lines.japanese: その先で閃光と銃声がほとばしり、乾いた大気を震わせた。鼓膜を襲ったその衝撃に、白い帳は破れ、時は動き、色づいた世界に俺は帰還した。首の後ろに重い痛みが残っていた。
lines.english: Light and gunfire erupted there, shaking the dry air. The blow to my eardrums tore the white curtain apart. Time resumed. I returned to a world restored to color. A heavy ache remained at the back of my neck.

lines.japanese: 「雑魚がァァァッ！　そいつに手ェ出すんじゃねェェェェ！！」
lines.english: “YOU SMALL-FRY BASTARD! DON'T YOU LAY A HAND ON HIIIIIM!”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、ひいっ……」
lines.english: “E-eek...”

lines.japanese: 肉迫した猛禽が片翼をかざした。最後の機会を誤射で終えたオウム頭の表情は、その瞬間、焦りと恐れに歪んだ。
lines.english: The raptor was upon him, wounded wing raised. Parrot Head's last chance had ended in a wild shot; now his face twisted with panic and fear.

lines.japanese: 鳳の燃えるような右腕が凍える空間を突きやぶった。フレイムバードの蹴爪は大司教の厚化粧を捕え、俺の鼻先をかすめ、あの極彩色の後頭部を落書きだらけのコンクリートへと叩きつけた。
lines.english: Ohtori's burning right arm smashed through the frozen air. The Flame Bird's talon caught the Archbishop across his heavy makeup, skimmed the tip of my nose, and slammed the riot-colored back of his head into the graffiti-covered concrete.

lines.japanese: <10>\「うがあああっ！」
lines.english: “GAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: にぶい音と凄惨な絶叫が響いて、大司教の手から墨色の凶器がこぼれ落ちた。
lines.english: A dull impact and a ghastly scream rang out. The ink-black weapon fell from the Archbishop’s hand.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハハ！　雑魚がッ！　しょせん貴様はオードブル！」
lines.english: “HAHAHAHAHA! SMALL FRY! YOU WERE ONLY THE APPETIZER!”

lines.japanese: 鳳はいったん腕を引き、ふたたびオウムの頭をくすんだ壁に打ちこんだ。
lines.english: Ohtori drew his arm back, then drove the parrot's head into the dingy wall again.

lines.japanese: 「う……うぅ……っ」
lines.english: “Ugh... uhh...”

lines.japanese: 「失せろ端役ァァァ！」
lines.english: “BEGONE, BIT PLAYER!”

lines.japanese: その動作を息つく間もなく繰りかえすこと三回。がん、がん、がん！
lines.english: He repeated the motion three times without pausing for breath. *Bang. Bang. Bang!*

lines.japanese: 大司教は馬鹿みたいに口を開けたまま、ずるずると壁づたいに沈んでいった。
lines.english: Mouth hanging open like an idiot, the Archbishop slid down the wall.

lines.japanese: 「ククククク……！」
lines.english: “Heh-heh-heh...!”

lines.japanese: あとに残った赤黒い染みと、振りかえった鳳の凄絶な笑みとが、群れて粋がっていた子供たちから戦意と敵意を根こそぎ奪ってゆく。
lines.english: The black-red stain left behind and Ohtori's savage smile as he turned stripped every last scrap of fight and hostility from the children who had been swaggering in a pack.

lines.japanese: 俺は痛みの引いてゆく後頭部に手を添え、大きく頭を振った。クソが、呆けてる場合じゃない。
lines.english: I put a hand to the fading ache in the back of my head and shook hard. Fuck. This was no time to stand there gaping.

lines.japanese: 俺は飛びつくようにピストルを拾って（いやな感触）、壁づたいにその場から数歩離れた。こんなものが無防備に転がっていたら、事態がさらに悪化しかねない。
lines.english: I pounced on the pistol and snatched it up—horrible thing to touch—then moved several steps away along the wall. Leaving it lying around where anyone could grab it could only make things worse.

lines.japanese: そして、銃を回収した俺と擦れちがうように、鳳翔が──
lines.english: And as I recovered the gun, Kakeru Ohtori passed close by me—

lines.japanese: 「カラス！　しつけがなってねェ！」
lines.english: “Crow! Your pets are badly trained!”

lines.japanese: ──ハリュー・クロードの頭めがけ、槍のような一撃を繰りだした。
lines.english: —and thrust a spear-like blow at Haryu Claude's head.

lines.japanese: 「キィィィアアアァァァ──ッ！」
lines.english: “HRAAAAAAAH!”

lines.japanese: 「めんどくせえな」
lines.english: “What a pain in the ass.”

lines.japanese: 最後まで座していた男が、ついに木箱の上から飛びのいた。鳳の右手が空を突きやぶる。
lines.english: The man who had remained seated to the last finally sprang from his crate. Ohtori's right hand punched through empty air.

lines.japanese: 「こっちだよ」
lines.english: “Over here.”

lines.japanese: 勢いづいて前へ傾いたその長躯に、ハリューが着地ざまの右足を水平に振りかざした。今度は鳳があとずさる。からぶったブーツが短い唸りをあげた。
lines.english: Ohtori’s tall frame pitched forward with its own momentum. As Haryu landed, he swept his right foot horizontally at him. This time Ohtori drew back. The boot cut empty air with a short growl.

lines.japanese: 「フ、フハハハハハ！　当たるかよ、そんな棒っきれ！」
lines.english: “H-ha ha ha ha! You think that twig's going to hit me?”

lines.japanese: 「……ファック」
lines.english: “...Fuck.”

lines.japanese: 「ようやく遊ぶ気になったかァ……相変わらず出足が遅えなカラス、はやくギアをトップまで上げてくれよ……」
lines.english: “Finally feel like playing...? Slow off the line as ever, Crow. Hurry up and shift all the way into top gear...”

lines.japanese: 鳳は負傷してない方の腕を引いて、胸の前で凍える夜気を握りつぶした。
lines.english: Ohtori drew back his unwounded arm and crushed the freezing night air in his fist before his chest.

lines.japanese: 「やだね」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: ハリューは浮いた脚でバレエダンサーのように流れる円軌道を描いてから、乾いたアスファルトに両足を付けた。しゃん……音の途絶えたその一瞬の夜に、小さな鈴の音が沁みわたった。
lines.english: With his raised leg, Haryu traced a circle as fluid as a ballet dancer, then planted both feet on the dry asphalt. *Chime...* In that instant when all other sound had died, the tiny bell rang through the night.

lines.japanese: 「飛ばしっぱなしじゃ客はすぐ飽きるよ」
lines.english: “Keep it at full throttle nonstop and the audience gets bored.”

lines.japanese: やつの目に光が灯ると、次の瞬間にはもう両者の戦いが始まっていた。
lines.english: Light kindled in his eyes. By the next instant, the fight had already begun.

lines.japanese: 戦意を粉々に砕かれていた信者たちが、トーンの低いどよめきをあげる。やつらにとってはハリュー・クロードの動きひとつひとつが、心おどる演舞のように見えるのかもしれない。
lines.english: The believers, their will to fight pulverized, gave a low murmur. Perhaps every movement Haryu Claude made looked to them like a dance to set the heart racing.

lines.japanese: 俺は──
lines.english: I—

lines.japanese: ──俺はつい拾ってしまった危険なおもちゃを、落ちつかない心持ちで見下ろした。汗ばみかけた手にグリップが冷たい。
lines.english: —I looked uneasily down at the dangerous toy I'd picked up without thinking. The grip was cold in my hand, which had begun to sweat.

lines.japanese: 映画やニュースでなら見たことがあるトカレフ。あるいはその模造品かもしれない。チャイニーズマフィアが濫造していてこの国にもたくさん入りこんでるってのは、お茶の間でも有名な話。
lines.english: A Tokarev. I'd seen them in movies and on the news. Or maybe this one was a knockoff. Chinese mobsters cranked them out and flooded Japan with them—that was common knowledge even to people sitting at home.

lines.japanese: きっとこれの中には、この弾倉には、胸くそ悪い凶弾がまだ何発か残っているのだろう。こんなもの、さっさとその辺に放りだして立ちさりたい。だが、そのせいで明日の新聞が賑わったりすれば寝覚めが悪い。
lines.english: There were probably still several of those sickening bullets in the magazine. I wanted to fling the thing away and leave. But if that put tomorrow’s papers into an uproar, I would never sleep right.

lines.japanese: 「おい！　おい、おまえっ！」
lines.english: “Hey! Hey, you!”

lines.japanese: 派手に暴れまわるカラスとニワトリのド突き合いをかいくぐって、俺は俺を殺そうとした男に怒声を浴びせた。
lines.english: Weaving through the flamboyant slugfest between Crow and Chicken, I shouted at the man who had tried to kill me.

lines.japanese: 汝の敵を赦せ──俺はじいさんが好きだった言葉を思いだして、くすぶりかけた黒い感情をこぶしで握りしめた。幸か不幸か、俺はそういう教育を受けている。世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: Forgive your enemies—I remembered words Grandpa had loved and closed my fist around the black feeling beginning to smolder. For better or worse, that was how I'd been raised. *May peace prevail on Earth*.

lines.japanese: 膝をついて、男の口元に耳を近づける。締まりのない唇から、ぜろぜろと耳慣れない呼吸音が漏れていた。返事はなかったが、息があるのはまだ幸いだ。
lines.english: I knelt and brought an ear near the man's mouth. A wet, unfamiliar rattle leaked through his slack lips. No answer, but at least he was still breathing.

lines.japanese: 「クソ野郎どもが……やめろおまえら。おい、やめろって」
lines.english: “Goddamn bastards... Stop it, both of you. Hey! I said stop!”

lines.japanese: 俺は立ちあがって、馬鹿二匹に停戦命令を投じた。しかしやつらはまるで耳を貸さない。
lines.english: I stood and ordered the two idiots to call a truce. Neither even pretended to listen.

lines.japanese: 際立った力の衝突と技の応酬は、まるで念入りに稽古されたパフォーマンスのごとく見る者を虜にしていた。しかし実のところ、その場の誰よりも喜悦に酔いしれているのは、血と汗をたぎらせて戦う当人たちだ。
lines.english: The collision of extraordinary power, the exchange of technique, held every witness captive like a performance rehearsed to perfection. In truth, nobody there was more drunk on delight than the combatants themselves, their blood and sweat boiling.

lines.japanese: ここにいるのは、戦争ごっこやチャンバラごっこの大好きな、救いきれないガキ大将ふたり。
lines.english: Before me stood two hopeless playground tyrants who loved nothing more than make-believe war and sword fights.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハーッ！」
lines.english: “Hahahahahaa!”

lines.japanese: 攻勢なのは鳳の方だ。しかし、上がらない左腕の袖口からは赤い線がつたって、薄明るい歩道にいくつもの点を落としていた。
lines.english: Ohtori held the offensive. Yet a red thread ran from the cuff of his unresponsive left arm, dropping bead after bead onto the dim sidewalk.

lines.japanese: 「はン、よく鳴くニワトリだ」
lines.english: “Hah. The Chicken does love to crow.”

lines.japanese: 一方のハリュー・クロードは優雅とさえ言える身さばきで相手の攻撃を、かわし、ながし、受けとめる──
lines.english: Haryu Claude, meanwhile, evaded, turned aside, and caught every attack with movements one might almost call graceful—

lines.japanese: ──そして舞い、踊り、跳ねまわる。ウインタースポーツのエア演技さながらに出来過ぎた動き。年頃のガキどもが魅了されるのも無理はない。
lines.english: —then wheeled, danced, and sprang. His moves were almost too perfect, like a winter-sports aerial routine. No wonder kids that age were hooked.

lines.japanese: 「おい、もうやめろ」
lines.english: “Hey. That’s enough.”

lines.japanese: 「キシャァァッ！」
lines.english: “SKREEEEE!”

lines.japanese: 鳳の右腕が、低い位置から振りあげられた。
lines.english: Ohtori’s right arm swept upward from below.

lines.japanese: 「Ｓｈｉｔ！」
lines.english: “Shit!”

lines.japanese: ハリューは左足を軸に身をよじってかわした。そのままアウトサイドターンを決め、高い後ろ回し蹴りで敵の頭を狙う。
lines.english: Haryu twisted around his planted left foot and slipped the blow. He flowed straight into an outside turn and sent a high spinning back kick at his enemy's head.

lines.japanese: 「見えてンだよ」
lines.english: “I can see it coming.”

lines.japanese: 鳳はそれを右腕一本で受けとめた。
lines.english: Ohtori caught it with his right arm alone.

lines.japanese: 「そうか？」
lines.english: “Can you?”

lines.japanese: ハリューはすぐさま蹴り足を引き、しかし軸足を換え、飛びつくようなもう一撃を送った。
lines.english: Haryu instantly recoiled the kicking leg, switched his plant foot, and sprang into another strike.

lines.japanese: 「それも見えてンだよ！」
lines.english: “I can see that too!”

lines.japanese: 鳳は掌打を真下へ振りおろし、襲いくる日本刀のような細い足を蝿でも潰すみたいに上から弾いた。
lines.english: Ohtori hammered a palm strike straight down, swatting the slender leg that came at him like a sword blade as if crushing a fly.

lines.japanese: 一瞬ハリューの体が揺らいだ。鳳はこれ見よがしに相手を模倣した。
lines.english: Haryu's body wavered for an instant. Ohtori made a show of imitating his opponent.

lines.japanese: 「それァこうやんだろ！」
lines.english: “This is how it's done!”

lines.japanese: 飛びつくようなミドルサイドキック。ハリューは平衡を失っていたが、しかし本能のような速さでガードだけは堅めた。
lines.english: A leaping side kick to the midsection. Haryu was off balance, but his guard snapped together with the speed of instinct.

lines.japanese: 「ファック……！」
lines.english: “Fuck...!”

lines.japanese: だが脇腹への直撃は防いだものの不安定な体は衝撃に踊らされ、浅黒い芸術家は凍えるコンクリートの壁に背中から抱きとめられた。
lines.english: The guard spared his ribs a direct hit, but the impact made his unstable body dance, and the freezing concrete wall caught the dark-skinned artist against its chest.

lines.japanese: 「くふっ！」
lines.english: “Guh!”

lines.japanese: 間断なく、鳳の開いた右手がハリューの頭部めがけて突きだされる。
lines.english: Without a pause, Ohtori's open right hand thrust toward Haryu's head.

lines.japanese: 「おい、もうやめろって！」
lines.english: “Hey, I said that’s enough!”

lines.japanese: 「クハハハ、もらったァァァーッ！！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Got yooou!”
“Not yet...!”

lines.japanese: ハリューは壁に身を預けたまま、首から上だけをわずかに傾けた。猛禽の蹴爪は、黒い髪をかすって湖のような眼のすぐ脇に突きたった──
lines.english: Still resting against the wall, Haryu tilted only his head a fraction. The raptor's talon skimmed black hair and planted itself beside those lake-like eyes—

lines.japanese: <5>\「てめえらァ！　やめろっつってんだろ！」
lines.english: “You bastards! I told you to stop!”

lines.japanese: ──そしてそのまま、両者の動きは止まった。
lines.english: —and there both men stopped.

lines.japanese: 見下ろす王様。天を睨むジプシー。動かないふたり。愛を睦ぶ男女のような距離で、燃える瞳と凍えた眼光だけがぶつかり合っていた。
lines.english: The king looking down. The wanderer glaring at the heavens. Neither moved. At a distance fit for lovers entwined, only burning eyes and frozen light collided.
“Hmph...”

lines.japanese: 「クククク……」
lines.english: “Heh-heh-heh...”

lines.japanese: 壁に手をついたまま、鳳の肩は静かに、やがて激しく揺れた。
lines.english: His hand still braced against the wall, Ohtori's shoulders began to shake—quietly at first, then violently.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハ……！」
lines.english: “Hahahaha...!”

lines.japanese: 「ハーッハッハッハッ！　カラス！　おまえは何故そんなにも弱い！」
lines.english: “HAAHAHAHAHA! CROW! WHY ARE YOU SO WEAK?”

lines.japanese: 王の高笑いは白い息となって広がり、夜に溶ける。屈さないジプシーの唇がかすかに吊りあがった。
lines.english: The king’s great laugh spread in a cloud of white breath and dissolved into night. The unbowed wanderer’s lips curled faintly upward.

lines.japanese: 「愚問だな。答えなら今の言葉の中にあったろ？」
lines.english: “Stupid question. Wasn't the answer in the words you just said?”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつがまともに笑ったのを初めて見た気がしたが、それはさほど長く続かなかった。
lines.english: I thought it might be the first time I'd seen him smile properly. It didn't last long.

lines.japanese: 「俺はライオンじゃない。ウサギやニワトリを狩るのに、いちいち全力は尽くさないんだよ」
lines.english: “I'm no lion. I don't waste my full strength hunting rabbits or chickens.”

lines.japanese: 濡れた声で囁いて、都会のカラスは素早く膝を振りあげた。ニワトリが飛びのく。黒色の膝から下が、鞭のようにしなって風を切った。
lines.english: He whispered in a wet voice, and the city crow snapped one knee upward. The Chicken sprang clear. From the black-clad knee down, the leg flexed like a whip and cut the air.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！　なかなか上手いことを言う噺家だ。隼人、そいつに古新聞の一枚でもくれてやれ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! A pretty good line, storyteller. Hayato, toss him a sheet of old newspaper!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、俺に振んなよ」
lines.english: “Don't drag me into it.”

lines.japanese: 趣味の悪い小噺には乗らず、俺は冷めきった声でくだらない流れを断ちきった。
lines.english: I refused to join the tasteless little routine and cut its idiotic momentum with a voice gone cold.

lines.japanese: 「つか、おまえら、マジでもうやめとけって。ぼちぼち潮時だろ。こぶしとこぶしの番長ごっこならまだしも、こういうの出てくっと収拾つかなくなんぜ」
lines.english: Seriously, you two, knock it off already. It's about time you called it quits. Playing gang boss with your fists is one thing, but once one of these comes out, the whole thing gets out of hand.

lines.japanese: 俺は拾いものの自動拳銃をつまむように掲げた。こんなちんまいのに、存在感は妙にでかい。
lines.english: I held up the automatic I'd found, pinching it between my fingers. Tiny little thing, but it had this weirdly huge presence.

lines.japanese: 「な、ほら解散解散。聞き分けのない子は、おにいさんバキュンといっちゃうよ」
lines.english: “Come on. Show’s over, show’s over. Any naughty children who won’t listen—the nice man goes *bang-bang*.”

lines.japanese: 引くつもりもない引き金に指をかけて、俺はニワトリとカラスとカラスの信者たちへ、ずらっと一通り銃口を向けた。
lines.english: I put my finger on a trigger I had no intention of pulling and swept the muzzle across Chicken, Crow, and all Crow's followers.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ、驚いたぞファルコン！　おまえにそれが撃てるのか！　そいつは人殺しのための道具だぞ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! You surprise me, Falcon! Can you fire that thing? It's a tool made to kill people!”

lines.japanese: 「撃つだけならそう難しくないよ、当てるにはそれなりの修練が必要だけどな」
lines.english: “Pulling the trigger isn't that hard. Hitting anything takes practice, though.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、俺のことはいんだよ。ほらカラス、お開きだ、太鼓しまって歯ァ磨いてクソして寝ろ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Nobody's talking about me. Crow, party's over. Put your drum away, brush your teeth, take a shit, and go to bed.”

lines.japanese: 「ニワトリ、おめーも。早ええとこお医者さん行って、肩のタマ抜いてもらえ。どんだけアドレナリン出てようが、痛くねーとかぜってーありえねーからソレ。ヤセ我慢やめとけ」
lines.english: “You too, Chicken. Get to a doctor and have the bullet taken out of your shoulder. I don't care how much adrenaline you've got pumping—there is no way that doesn't hurt. Knock off the macho act.”

lines.japanese: 「おー。おーコラ、シカトしてんなよクソども。まとめてバキュンといっちゃうぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Hey. Hey, assholes, don’t ignore me. I’ll start going *bang-bang* at the whole lot of you.”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、不愉快だなあんた。ハヤブサ。俺をそのイカれた暇人と同列に並べるなよ。俺はただ降りかかる家禽の羽根を払ってるだけだ」
lines.english: “Hmph. You're an unpleasant man, Falcon. Don't put me on the same level as that deranged idler. I'm merely brushing aside the feathers of a domestic fowl that came fluttering down on me.”

lines.japanese: 「クク……よく言う。聞こえよがしな囃子太鼓でひとを呼びよせたのはどこのカラスだ、あァ？　貴様はどこかの誰かにボコられて、ストレス溜まってたんだァ、なあそうだろお？」
lines.english: “Kuku... look who's talking. What Crow was banging a drum loud enough to make damn sure I heard it, huh? Somebody beat you up, and you had some stress to work off. That's it, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 「おーコラ、待てって。やめろって。おまえら、もっとアレだよ、仲良くケンカしろよ。な、あんだろ他に。あの、ゲームとかスポーツとか、ボトルキャップ集めた数とかそんなん」
lines.english: “Hey, wait. Come on, stop. You two need to... I don't know, play nice when you fight. Right? There's gotta be something else. Video games, sports, who collected the most bottle caps—something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「はあぁぁぁ……やめろファルコン……」
lines.english: “Haaaaah... Stop, Falcon...”

lines.japanese: 鳳は左腕の袖口からこぼれる赤い雫を、反対側の指で一すくいして舌の上へ運んだ。その下顎は小刻みに蠕動していた。
lines.english: Ohtori scooped a red drop from the cuff of his left sleeve with a finger of his other hand and carried it to his tongue. His lower jaw worked in small, restless motions.

lines.japanese: 「もう喋るな……おま、おまえは本当につま、つま、つまらない……つまらない男だ……」
lines.english: “Stop... talking... You, you really are so b-b-boring... such a boring man...”

lines.japanese: 「おま、おまえはいつ……いつ、いつ、いつから他人の節介を焼くような、りょ、良、良識人になった……あま、あまり気の滅入ることを言うな……バ、ババ、バ、バッドに入るじゃねえか……！」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-when did you... when, when did you become the k-kind, decent citizen who meddles in other people’s business...? D-don’t say things that depressing... You’ll send me into a b-b-b-bad trip...!”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　知らねえよ。もともと俺は、おまえほどブッ壊れちゃいねーっつうの」
lines.english: “Huh? How should I know? I was never as completely broken as you.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は頭を落とし、震えるような溜息をついた。不意に冬の夜の寒さでも思いだしたかのだろうか、その両腕をかき抱く。
lines.english: Ohtori let his head fall and breathed a shivering sigh. As if abruptly reminded of the winter night, he wrapped both arms around himself.

lines.japanese: その表情からは、爛々とたぎる熱っぽさがにわかに失せていた。まさに左肩の銃創が痛みだしたのか。
lines.english: The feverish blaze vanished abruptly from his face. Had the gunshot wound in his left shoulder finally begun hurting in earnest?

lines.japanese: 「わわわわ忘れるなよファル……は、はや隼人、おおおれおれ、俺がもてあましてる要因は、おまおま、おまえにもある、ある、あるる、あるんだぜ」
lines.english: “D-d-d-don’t you forget, Fal—H-Hayato... Y-you, you’re one of the r-reasons I don’t know what to do with myself... you, you know...”

lines.japanese: 「知るかっつの。くだらねーケチつけてねえで、早よコタツで丸くなって寝ろ。歯ァ噛みあってねえぞ」
lines.english: “Like I give a shit. Quit picking stupid fights and go curl up somewhere warm and sleep it off. Your teeth won't stop chattering.”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、尾羽を巻いて逃げんのかいニワトリ。文字通りのチキンだな」
lines.english: “Hmph. Running away with your tail feathers tucked, Chicken? A literal chicken.”

lines.japanese: 「きょ、きょきょ、興が削がれた……カカ、カラス……きょきょきょ、きょうの、今日のレクリエーションはここここまでだ」
lines.english: “I-I-I've lost interest... C-C-Crow... T-t-today's recreation ends here.”

lines.japanese: 「ここ、こけっ、これっ、これ以上は、バ、ババ、バッドに落ちる……ささ、さい、さいさい最悪だ……じゃじゃじゃ、じゃあな、あの、ばいばいシュウちゃん……ち違うか隼人だ、まいいや……」
lines.english: “Any m-m-more and I’ll fall into a b-b-b-bad trip... th-the absolute w-w-worst... S-s-see you, uh, bye-bye, Shu... No, Hayato. Whatever...”

lines.japanese: 鳳は右手に顔を埋め、震える体を引きずるようによろよろと歩きだした。千鳥足の猛禽。
lines.english: Ohtori buried his face in his right hand and lurched away as if dragging his trembling body behind him. A raptor staggering drunk.

lines.japanese: 片やハリュー・クロードは、何事もなかったかのようにふたたび木箱へ腰を下ろし、ミネラルウオーターのボトルを乱暴に掴んだ。
lines.english: Haryu Claude, meanwhile, sat back down on the wooden crate as though nothing had happened and snatched up the bottle of mineral water.

lines.japanese: 「ちっ……渇く……」
lines.english: “Tch... So thirsty...”

lines.japanese: やつはほとんど聞きとれないような独り言を囁いて、浴びるように透明の液体を飲んだ。唇の端から溢れた水が、喉をつたって衣服の下へ滑りおちていた。
lines.english: He whispered the almost inaudible words to himself, then drank the clear liquid as if trying to bathe in it. Water spilled from one corner of his mouth, ran down his throat, and slipped beneath his clothes.

lines.japanese: 気味悪いほどの速さで飲みほすと、やつは空になったペットボトルを斜め後ろへ放りなげた。それは壁を赤黒く染めて動かないオウムのような頭に弾かれ、冷たい歩道の隅に転がった。
lines.english: He drained it with unsettling speed and tossed the empty bottle over his shoulder. It bounced off the motionless, parrot-like head that had stained the wall dark red and rolled into a corner of the cold pavement.

lines.japanese: 鳳を目で追えば、やつは行く手を阻むＲ－ウィングの残存兵を右腕一本で蹴散らし、燃えつきたような足取りでガード下から遠ざかっていった。
lines.english: I followed Ohtori with my eyes. He scattered the surviving R-Wing soldiers blocking his path with his one good arm, then stumbled out from beneath the viaduct as though all his fire had burned away.

lines.japanese: ハリュー・クロードは木箱の中にジェンベを収め、革ベルトを使って手際よくそれを背負った。お帰りは狂えるニワトリと反対側の出口から。
lines.english: Haryu Claude packed the djembe into its wooden case and quickly strapped it to his back. Our guest will be departing through the exit opposite the mad Chicken.

lines.japanese: そして俺はピストルを──
lines.english: And then there was the pistol—

lines.japanese: ──どうするべきか、しばし考えた。もちろん善良な一般市民の俺に、こんなヤバいゴミを拾う趣味はない。さりとて善良な一般市民だけに、こんなヤバい男の手元に残しておくのも座りが悪い。
lines.english: —I considered for a moment what to do with it. Naturally, as a decent, law-abiding citizen, I had no desire to collect dangerous trash. Yet precisely because I was a decent, law-abiding citizen, leaving it with such a dangerous man didn't sit right either.

lines.japanese: 俺は折衷案を取ることにした。誰も見ていない隙に素早く銃を拾いあげ、ガキのころのモデルガン知識だけで弾倉を抜きとる。
lines.english: I settled on a compromise. The moment nobody was looking, I scooped up the gun and, relying on nothing more than what I remembered from playing with replica guns as a kid, removed the magazine.

lines.japanese: そいつを自分のポケットへねじ込み、本体は持ち主の足元へ返却。弾が入れられなきゃオイタは出来ないだろう。
lines.english: I crammed the magazine into my pocket and returned the unloaded pistol to its owner's feet. He couldn't get up to any more mischief if he had nothing to load into it.

lines.japanese: 大司教は依然として、意識のないままぜろぜろ呼吸している。下手に動かすのさえヤバそうだ。臆病な仲間たちが寄りあつまって、おろおろと青ざめた互いの顔を見つめあっていた。
lines.english: The Archbishop remained unconscious, breathing in wet, rasping gulps. Even moving him carelessly looked dangerous. His cowardly companions gathered around and traded helpless looks through bloodless faces.

lines.japanese: 口元を赤く染めてうずくまっていた佐久間に、俺は早く救急車を呼んでやれと言いのこしてガード下をあとにした。
lines.english: Sakuma crouched there with his mouth stained red. I told him to hurry and call an ambulance, then left the viaduct behind.

lines.japanese: その後、いつもの工事現場には、ちょっと遠回りをして向かった。柳木原のはずれを通る都会の汚い河に、俺は橋の上からトカレフ（あるいは偽トカレフ）のマガジンを落とした。
lines.english: Afterward, I took the long way around to my usual construction site. From a bridge at the edge of Yanagihara, I dropped the Tokarev's magazine—or the fake Tokarev's—into one of the city's filthy rivers.

lines.japanese: ひゅうぅぅぅ、ぼちょん。
lines.english: Whiiiiistle... *plop.*

lines.japanese: 生活廃水に汚染された濁りの奥へ、あっという間に呑みこまれる大人の玩具。
lines.english: The toy for grown men vanished in an instant beneath murky water polluted by household runoff.

lines.japanese: こうして大きな悪ガキたちの戦争ごっこは幕を閉じた。
lines.english: And so the overgrown brats' game of war came to an end.
